page.heading: Plan what matters, track progress.
page.introEditor: Set a target, record money as you put it aside, and see how much to save each month to get there on time.
page.introViewer: The household's savings goals and how close they are. Only owners and editors can change them.
page.forecastSubtitle: What's likely left over each month, based on your income, fixed bills and recent spending.
page.newGoalSubtitle: What are you saving for, and how much do you need?
page.completedSubtitle: Goals you've reached. Reopen one to keep saving towards it.

card.confirmDelete: Delete {name} and its history? This can't be undone.

actions.startingInvalid: Enter an amount, e.g. 250, or leave it empty.
actions.onlySaved: Only {amount} is saved for this goal.
actions.genericError: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.

view.saveAbout: Save about {amount} a month to reach it by {date}.
view.datePassed: Target date {date} has passed; {amount} still to go.
view.projectionNew: A projected date appears after its first full month.
view.stalled_one: Nothing added in the last {count} full month, so there's no projected date yet.
view.stalled_other: Nothing added in the last {count} full months, so there's no projected date yet.
view.reach: At your recent pace (about {amount} a month) you'd reach it in {month}.

view.reachLate_other: At your recent pace (about {amount} a month) you'd reach it in {month}, {count} months after the target date.

forecast.moreOut: More goes out than comes in
forecast.noGoals: No active goals with a target date

forecast.allAside: If you put all that's left over aside

forecast.covered: Covered, with {amount} a month to spare
forecast.moreThanLeft: {amount} a month more than is left over

forecast.basisHistory_other: Typical spending is the average of the last {count} full months of logged expenses. In a category with a fixed bill, only spending above the bill counts, so a bill you also log as an expense isn't counted twice.
